execution.description: Typed the campaign ledger's limit refusals so a task its own ceiling refused completes as MINER_CEILING_REACHED instead of FAILED_INFRA / INTERNAL.

expected: A practice task refused by the campaign's own research_trials ceiling tells the miner which ceiling bound and how to raise it.
observed: Two practice tasks on a campaign with research_trials 3 of 3 used ended FAILED_INFRA / INTERNAL in about 0.5 s with no stored reason, indistinguishable from a worker crash: the durable provider's blanket except turned the ledger's ValueError into INTERNAL.
keep: Refusing work against the miner's own ceiling before anything is reserved.
INTERNAL for every exception the executor cannot type.
change: A limit refusal is a typed exception carrying the dimension and the counts, with its historical text, so text readers keep working.
A blanket except around an executor asks the executor to type what it recognises before falling back to INTERNAL.
A refusal says whose limit it is and names the launch field that sets it.
